nameOrigin: of or relating to the Sun

pokedexEntries.su: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

pokedexEntries.mo: This Pokémon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.

pokedexEntries.us: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

pokedexEntries.um: In writings from the distant past, it’s called by the name “the beast that devours the sun.”

pokedexEntries.sw: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

pokedexEntries.sh: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
